prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web interface concept, 1440 × 900 landscape
Primary request: Redesign the ‘Memories’ page for the personal archive ‘nono & txx’. This is an Experience surface where the photographs lead. The concept is ‘Memory Horizon’: two continuous horizontal photo streams form one quiet horizon across the full viewport; when a photograph is paused, a related event on the timeline below subtly responds.
Real content: ‘nono & txx’, ‘Memories’, ‘since 2025.09.17’, ‘我们的回忆正在慢慢变长’, ‘管理照片’, ‘暂停’, ‘时间线’, ‘故事从这里开始’, ‘一次普通却珍贵的见面’, ‘立即备份’.
Reading order: very compact utility header; restrained title and relationship metadata; two full-width staggered photo rails using complete uncropped portraits and life photos; a selected photo with a small date and event line; the beginning of a narrative timeline section below, visibly connected to the selected photo. Management controls are quiet and secondary.
Frame: finished edge-to-edge website screen with navigation, utility controls, first viewport and the beginning of the next section. No browser chrome, device mockup, desk, or poster framing.
Reference image contribution: preserve its neutral warm-white ground, refined serif/sans contrast, quiet spacing, thin rules, and understated component character. Do not copy its old oversized title, equal card repetition, yellow star placeholder, or exact layout.
Visual law: warm paper-white ground, near-black ink, one muted wine accent only for active state; uncoated photographic paper, hairline metal timeline marks; no gradients, no glassmorphism, no heavy shadows. The photos remain the dominant content.
Constraints: this must read as a real working website, not a poster; visible pause control; readable Chinese text; no black photo viewer; no decorative icons; no fake commercial claims; no watermark.
